clips.title: The story
paras: In Ban'ethil Barrow Den, Oben Rageclaw's spirit wanders, unable to wake or pass on. His sleeping body remains under the Gnarlpine furbolgs' control.

Oben Rageclaw entered Ban'ethil Barrow Den to commune with nature and wander the Emerald Dream, as many Druids of the Claw do. When the Gnarlpine furbolgs fell to corruption and overran the barrows, Oben lay defenseless in his trance. A corrupted Gnarlpine shaman used dark rituals to take control of his comatose body. His spirit was left behind as an anguished ghost, unable to wake or pass on.
